hero.title: EUDR Compliance Platform for Importers — Meet the Deforestation Regulation Deadline
hero.subtitle: Antaios extracts data from your import documents to cover all 5 EUDR due-diligence criteria and generate your DDS.

trust.text: Built around the exact 5 due-diligence criteria under Article 10(2), EU Regulation 2023/1115.

problem.q1: "Who sent which documents? Which shipments still need geolocation?"
problem.q2: "What happens when the auditor asks for our due-diligence records?"
problem.q3: "Are we actually compliant — or just hoping we are?"
problem.contrast: Enterprise tools charge €12,000+/year and take months to set up. Antaios does what you actually need, starting at €500/month.
problem.header: Enterprise tools overcharge. Antaios just delivers.
problem.body: What a PME actually needs — not what an enterprise account bills for. Operational in an afternoon, not a quarter.

step1.title: Enter your shipments
step1.desc: Upload CSV files, PDF invoices, or shipping manifests directly into Antaios. Or add shipments one by one through our streamlined form — no special formatting required. Antaios automatically parses and organizes your data so nothing slips through the cracks.

step2.title: Antaios scores your risk
step2.desc: Antaios instantly evaluates every shipment against all five EUDR criteria: traceability, geolocation, documentation, attestations, and legality. Each criterion is scored and flagged green, amber, or red so you can see your compliance gaps at a glance. Your risk profile is calculated in seconds — no more manual spreadsheet work.

step3.title: Generate your DDS
step3.desc: With a single click, Antaios compiles your due-diligence statement (DDS) for every shipment. The statement is formatted to TRACES specifications, ready to file without any rework. What used to take hours of paperwork is now one button press.

step4.title: Audit trail retained
step4.desc: All your compliance records — risk scores, supporting documents, and filed DDS statements — are stored securely for the full 5-year regulatory retention period. When an auditor requests records, you can retrieve and export the complete file within 24 hours. Peace of mind that you are always inspection-ready.

pricing.title: All-inclusive. €500/month.
pricing.caveat: If you're a downstream trader just storing reference numbers rather than a full importer, a lighter tool may suit you better. We'll tell you honestly if that's the case.

q1.q: Is this sufficient for TRACES filing?
q1.a: Yes. Antaios generates a due-diligence statement that meets the requirements of Article 10(2) and can be used for TRACES submission.

q2.q: What if I'm not a large enterprise?
q2.a: The free diagnostic adjusts the EUDR deadline based on your company size — small/micro enterprises have until June 30, 2027. Our pricing starts at €500/month regardless of size.

q3.q: What if I'm a trader, not an importer?
q3.a: Traders still fall under EUDR obligations. Our diagnostic covers your case, and we'll include an honest assessment of whether a lighter tool may suit you better.

q4.a: Yes. We use encryption at rest and in transit. We process data through DeepL for optional translations — see our privacy policy for details.
